messages:
emily_support: FYI — QuikShop hitting repeated 429s during a marketing surge. They saw scale-up to dedicated take ~45s; many requests returned 429s. Escalating to eng.
remy_oncall: Can you paste sample errors and ded IDs?
emily_support: App logs: "error=rate_limited, code=429, retry_after=30". Our attach logs show queueing and "concurrency_gate: throttle" in runtime.
emily_support: Root ts: 1785554321. Region: us-west-2. Pool: dq-prod-west. min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20. Spike ~5x RPS for ~60s.
raj_runtime: Any autoscaler events or attach/backoff traces?
emily_support: Autoscaler timeline via metrics:
- 0s (1785554321): surge starts
- +18s: probes begin failing with 429
- +36s: attach attempts slow; no imagepull backoff
- +45s: pods Ready but model warmup ~6s each
- +60s: traffic mostly routed; customer saw 429s until ~+55s
lina_sre: "concurrency_gate: throttle" before pods ready => front-end gating rejecting while waiting for handshake. Probe failures can inhibit autoscaler.
emily_support: Customer attach logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-15T17:22:13Z] attach-request id=abc123 pool=dq-prod-west state=queued
[2026-03-15T17:22:17Z] attach-probe id=abc123 status=429 msg="probe-rate-limit"
[2026-03-15T17:22:25Z] attach-request id=abc123 status=started pod=pod-7 ready=false
[2026-03-15T17:22:31Z] runtime: concurrency_gate=throttle current=40 limit=40
[2026-03-15T17:22:37Z] pod-ready pod=pod-7 model=llama-70b quantized=true warmup=6.2s
```
remy_oncall: Probes hitting probe-rate-limit before pods spin up -> false negatives. Autoscaler sees failures and backs off; front-end gate keeps rejecting.
raj_runtime: Do we have per-pool probe quotas? I thought probes were globally rate-limited.
lina_sre: We have token-bucket per-pool + global attach-probe limiter. High-fanout bursts can exhaust tokens and trigger exponential backoff on attach.
emily_support: Impact: ~18% requests 429'd in first 45s. They couldn't failover due to sticky routing.
raj_runtime: Repro plan: staging pool with min_replicas=2 and low probe quota; fire 5x QPS spike; capture probe rejections and concurrency gate events.
remy_oncall: Short-term mitigations:
- bump min_replicas -> 6
- enable warm-pool reserved burst
- advise client to reduce concurrency/retry settings
- route overflow to hosted fallback
emily_support: Customer asked for timeline and temporary fix.
lina_sre: Short-term: support can request min_replicas increase; ops can enable warm-pool for dq-prod-west.
raj_runtime: Medium-term: adjust probe quota strategy — prioritize attach probes for reserved pools; provide adaptive tokens on sudden surges.
remy_oncall: Action items:
- @raj_runtime: run staging repro and collect logs (ETA 2h)
- @lina_sre: evaluate warm-pool enablement and cost (ETA 1h)
- @emily_support: confirm customer OK with min_replicas bump & rollback plan (ETA 30m)
- @ops-bot: create ticket INC-17855
ops-bot: Incident INC-17855 created and assigned to oncall
raj_runtime: Hypothesis: probe-rate-limit + concurrency gating caused orchestration stall; autoscaler backoff slowed attach attempts.
lina_sre: Check for noisy neighbor in dq-prod-west — saw tenant churn at 17:21:40Z consuming probe tokens.
emily_support: QuikShop approved min_replicas -> 6. They lowered client concurrency. Want post-change logs and cost estimate.
remy_oncall: Monitor next 10min during traffic window. If 429s continue, escalate to platform-telemetry for traces.
raj_runtime: I'll post repro output. If probe budget exhaustion confirmed, propose prioritization for reserved pools and autoscaler heuristic ticket.
emily_support: Notifying customer: min_replicas bump + warm-pool enable in progress, ETA 30-60m. :thumbsup:
remy_oncall: Keep thread updated. Flag other 429 clusters here.
